title: Debugging in plain English
tagline: Ask a running FPGA a question in words and get a waveform and a plain answer that quotes only the capture
description: A plain-English request becomes a probe plan by RTL name, an on-chip logic analyser build in Vivado 2026.1 on the free licence tier, a capture on a Digilent Nexys A7 and an answer checked against the captured samples.

facts.text: 5 of 5 known-answer requests on one design, written in plain English, answered from captures on the board; each answer matched the known result, and the value read back over the serial link where a register was read back (one run each).
1 of the 5 requests needed no new build: an earlier debug build already held its signals (each new probe set otherwise took 7 to 9 minutes to build).
All 5 captures ran inside the recommended operating conditions, with 0 supply or temperature alarms.

media.alt: A recorded capture from the Nexys A7 replayed: a strip of the run's stages (request, plan, build, arm and capture, answer) with their real numbers, then the write strobe, the address byte and the counter filling in sample by sample, the trigger line at cycle 0 and the counter's change from 0x0003 to 0x1234 marked.
media.note: Recorded frame by frame from the showcase page's own hero, which replays one real run.

made_from: site/public/showcase/nl_debug.html (the hero player), captured by puppeteer and encoded with ffmpeg
